title: Microsoft Teams: expanded Markdown support in the compose box
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's notice, including the user-selected compose mode and expected December rollout. The Teams licence requirement is documented, and independent searches found no Markdown-specific admin control, licence requirement or meter.

claims.where: title; What's changing
claims.claim: Microsoft Teams plans expanded Markdown support in the compose box.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope: Users and platforms
claims.claim: The updated compose experience is for users composing messages in chats and channels.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams users who compose messages in chats and channels on supported platforms

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Users select Format in Markdown from the compose box's Actions and apps (+) menu.
claims.quote: Users will be able to select Format in Markdown from the compose box’s Actions and apps (+) menu (Screenshot 1).

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Markdown syntax remains visible and editable while users write in this mode.
claims.quote: Markdown authoring without live rendering: Syntax remains visible and editable while users write.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Formatting does not automatically render as users type in Markdown mode.
claims.quote: Users can write and edit with Markdown syntax intact, without formatting automatically rendering as they type.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: A dedicated Markdown toolbar lets users insert formatting syntax.
claims.quote: A dedicated Markdown toolbar: Users can insert syntax for formatting (Screenshot 2).

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Preview message shows rendered formatting before sending.
claims.quote: Message preview: Users can turn on Preview message to see the rendered formatting before sending (Screenshot 3).

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Format in rich text in the same Actions and apps (+) menu returns users to rich text authoring.
claims.quote: Switching between compose modes: Users can select Format in rich text from the same menu to return to rich text authoring (Screenshot 4).

claims.claim: Teams remembers the user's selected compose mode.
claims.quote: Teams will remember the user’s selected compose mode and apply it across chats and channels until the user switches modes.

claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is introducing an updated Markdown compose experience with expanded formatting support. Users can write and edit with Markdown syntax intact, without formatting automatically rendering as they type.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: No identity or sign-in change is described for this compose mode.

claims.quote: A dedicated Markdown toolbar helps users insert formatting syntax, preview the rendered message before sending, and switch between Markdown and rich text.

claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "Markdown" retention eDiscovery rendered source communication compliance DLP. Read excerpts from security-compliance-overview, retention-policies-teams and Communication Compliance; none specifies this compose mode's representation.
